reason: PURE. First thing I noticed was the pocket-size sachet that tears open with one hand, because I live out of a big tote and it would just ride along with my charger and snacks. $29.99 with free shipping is an easy impulse buy if a creator video hits my sleep and gym-recovery problem, and I'd try one box before anything else.
objection: 30 little foil packets feels like more trash, and I'm not sure why I need sachets when a bottle would do.
would_change_my_mind: If a creator showed the sachets are recyclable or the box is a smaller, cheaper pack I could try first, I'd feel better about it. If the price went over about $40 I'd skip it.
